findings.current: Speed, strength, a perfectly timed surprise attack—he’d made full use of them all, yet the gap between them was unmistakable.
findings.defect: The assembled text omits Jin Taekyung’s preceding spoken reaction, “그래, 한 수 위라 이거지……,” in which he acknowledges that his opponent is a step above him.
findings.rationale: The source includes this explicit acknowledgment before Jin reflects on the gap in their abilities; the assembled English drops it.
findings.replacement:
“So, you’re a cut above me…”

Speed, strength, a perfectly timed surprise attack—he’d made full use of them all, yet the gap between them was unmistakable.

summary: One brief line of Jin Taekyung’s dialogue is missing; the rest is faithful.
